preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between n - 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.
Each edge has a weight between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
There is at least one path between any two vertices in the graph.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The minimum number of operations required is non-negative.

invariants.expression: The MST cost remains k after the operations.
invariants.description: The total weight of the edges in the MST remains the same as the initial MST cost k.

invariants.expression: The MST is unique after the operations.
invariants.description: There is only one possible MST configuration after increasing the weights of some edges.
